decision.reasoning_trace: The consideration set focuses on highly-rated products from established brands (Sony, Bose, JBL, Jabra) alongside a high-wattage value option (BOGASING). The Sony SRS-XB43 (prod_181) is the final choice because it offers the most comprehensive feature set for a serious speaker, including IP67 waterproofing, 24-hour battery life, and high-quality sound with dedicated tweeters. Its 4.7 rating across over 5,000 reviews provides high confidence in its performance compared to cheaper, less powerful alternatives.
